title: Finding
description: One durable belief in research/FINDINGS.md. Findings are context compression, not a log: every entry cites evidence IDs, and an entry with no usable evidence cannot claim to be Established.

status.description: Refuted is the fate of a hypothesis. Superseded is the fate of a finding that was once believed and is now replaced, and it requires superseded_by and reason.

max_evidence_level.description: The highest evidence level among the cited records. Recomputed by the tool; a supplied value that disagrees is a state error.
